reading.zh: 从左到右：init 建表，descriptor-update 更新描述子，absorb 合并重复身份，assign 给轨迹分配身份；箭头是注册表逐级演进的顺序。
reading.en: Left to right: init builds the table, descriptor-update refreshes descriptors, absorb merges duplicate identities and assign gives tracks an identity; arrows are the order the registry evolves in.
